name: web-search
description: Search the web, return JSON {title, url, snippet} results. Backend auto-selects: TAVILY_API_KEY or BRAVE_API_KEY env vars, else a zero-key DuckDuckGo lite scrape. Follow up with web-fetch for the actual page.
use_when: searching the web for current facts or documentation

args.name: query
args.description: Search terms — keep short, one fact per query.

env.BRAVE_API_KEY: Prefer Brave backend when set (after Tavily).

stdout: JSON {query, backend, count, results: [{title, url, snippet}]}.
notes: Snippets are not sources — fetch the page (web-fetch) before citing a fact.
